title: Layout Upgrade & Permanent Fix — V-model spec delta (prd_items + requirements + test_cases + test_bindings)
derived_from: Discussion #172 (D-01/D-02 ratified, D-03 = PM multi-width audit) + community layout research — documentation only, zero new decisions

requirements.text: Card, form and table shells SHALL respond to their own width via CSS container queries (container-type + @container rules), not only to viewport breakpoints.

acceptance_criteria.then: container-type is declared on card/form/table shell selectors and at least one @container rule adjusts padding or columns

acceptance_criteria.given: a shell placed in a narrow parent on a wide viewport
acceptance_criteria.then: the shell restyles by container width (asserted via CSS presence test + resizer gate)

requirements.text: Headings and section spacing SHALL use clamp() fluid sizing instead of breakpoint-jumping fixed sizes.

acceptance_criteria.then: h1/h2/page-title and major section paddings use clamp(min, preferred, max)
type scales smoothly with no clipped or oversized headings (resizer gate)

requirements.text: Layout code SHALL contain zero fixed-pixel widths for structural elements (sidebar, chart labels, chips, columns); only non-layout tokens (borders, dots, icons) may use px.

acceptance_criteria.when: scanned by the fixed-px sweep test
acceptance_criteria.then: no structural width:Npx outside an allowlist (border/1px/icon sizes); chart-label and sidebar remnants converted to %/fr/rem with min/max
it fails if a new structural fixed-px width appears (regression guard)

requirements.text: KPI rows, form grids and detail groups SHALL use CSS Grid auto-fit/minmax skeletons so columns self-collapse across widths; dead CSS from removed components (F43) SHALL be removed.

acceptance_criteria.then: kpi-row, form grids and detail groups use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(...)) or equivalent grid skeletons
no rules referencing removed components (move-tabs, legend-zone, disclaimer-footer) remain

requirements.text: After the upgrade, EVERY layout SHALL be verified working across the full width matrix (320-1440) on both surfaces — the permanent fix is proven by the continuous-resizer gate, coverage pin, full suite and Waydroid smoke all green.

acceptance_criteria.when: resizer gate runs over all redesigned routes at 8 widths

acceptance_criteria.then: all tests pass including new fixed-px and container-query tests

acceptance_criteria.given: Waydroid smoke on the rebuilt APK
acceptance_criteria.then: DEVICE SMOKE: PASS — all screens render on the Android surface
every page inspected at 320/375/768/1440 — no visual defects remain

prd_items.statement: Zero structural fixed-pixel widths + sweep guard test.
Full multi-width verification of every layout on both surfaces.

test_cases.title: Container queries present on shells (UI-U1)
test_cases.steps: Parse theme.css: assert container-type and >=1 @container rule on card/form/table selectors.
test_cases.expected: Container-query rules exist and target the shells

test_cases.title: clamp() fluid type present (UI-U2)
test_cases.steps: Parse theme.css: assert clamp( on h1/h2/page-title and section padding rules.

test_cases.title: Fixed-px structural sweep (UI-U3)
test_cases.steps: Scan theme.css + template style blocks for width:Npx outside allowlist (border/icon sizes).
test_cases.expected: No structural fixed widths; test fails on regression

test_cases.title: Grid skeletons + dead CSS gone (UI-U4)
test_cases.steps: Assert auto-fit/minmax on kpi/form/detail; assert no move-tabs/legend-zone/disclaimer-footer rules remain.
test_cases.expected: Grid skeletons present; dead CSS absent

test_cases.title: Resizer gate full matrix (UI-U5)
test_cases.steps: Run test_resizer_gate over all redesigned routes at 320/360/375/414/480/768/1024/1440.

test_cases.title: Full suite + Waydroid smoke (UI-U5)
test_cases.steps: pytest full suite; build APK; device_smoke.sh.
test_cases.expected: All tests pass; DEVICE SMOKE: PASS
